messages.subject: Project Drake — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Aisha, Priya,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Series A has completed. The £8,000,000 has been received, the Series A Shares have been allotted and issued, the new Articles adopted, and the register of members updated. Eleanor's appointment as Investor Director takes effect today. We'll make the Companies House filings (SH01 and the special resolution) within the statutory deadline and send you a completion bible in due course.

Congratulations to the whole team.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
